title: Integral morphisms are stable under arbitrary base change
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be an integral morphism of schemes [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism], and let $g:Y\prime\to Y$ be any morphism. In any Cartesian square [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square] with $g\prime:X\prime\to X$ and $f\prime:X\prime\to Y\prime$, the morphism $f\prime$ is integral.
